contexts.text: Adulterers who move young and beautiful wives to dishonour.
Their wives shall be ravished () = that the goods of truth will be perverted by the evils of falsity.
To ravish the widows () = to pervert the goods which desire truth. That to ravish = to pervert, References. AE 601:13.
a. [4]. Those who have seduced virgins to dishonour, called to Judgment. Described.
The understanding, which is then the harlot of the will, has become so stupid from debauchery with the will...
Lust with... a virgin is (not fornication, but) a debauching.
Debauchings, which are violations of virgins, (are guarded against by this lesser evil).
This wickedness (defloration), which is a debauching (with such) remains inrooted.
The adulteration and falsification of the Word, is described by to be debauched ().
The debauching of a virgin = the falsification of Divine truth...
The excrementitious Hells are for those to whom debauchings of virgins have been deliciousnesses.
